description.value: Rockit Coffee Co. is a retro-themed independent café nestled in Whistler's Creekside Village, just steps from the Creekside Gondola. It leans into a groovy mid-century aesthetic with a food and drink menu, branded merchandise, and an online ordering option. Its location at the base of Whistler Creekside makes it a natural stop for cyclists heading into or out of the mountains.

address.value: 227-2063 Lake Placid Road, Whistler BC, Canada V8E 0B6
